title: Weil-equivariant coefficient long exact sequence for compact supports
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$ and an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. For every separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $S_0$ write $S=S_0\times_{k_0}k$. Use the common-stage coefficient categories $D^b_c(S,\Qlb)$, their constructible hearts and their Weil objects as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-weil-constructible-heart]. A Weil complex is a pair with a geometric-Frobenius isomorphism; no triangulated structure on the category of pairs is assumed. Write $Rf_{0!}$ for the compact-support functor of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], with its induced Weil structure, and $\mathcal H^r$ for the standard heart-valued cohomology functors [prop-constructible-truncations].

Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes. For a constructible Weil sheaf $F$, put $R^rf_{0!}F=\mathcal H^r(Rf_{0!}(F[0]))$ for $r\in\mathbf Z$. For every short exact sequence $0\to F'\xrightarrow{a}F\xrightarrow{b}F''\to0$ in the constructible Weil heart, the canonical underlying connecting maps induce morphisms of constructible Weil sheaves
$$\delta^r:R^rf_{0!}F''\longrightarrow R^{r+1}f_{0!}F'$$
for which
$$\cdots\to R^rf_{0!}F'\xrightarrow{R^rf_{0!}a}R^rf_{0!}F\xrightarrow{R^rf_{0!}b}R^rf_{0!}F''\xrightarrow{\delta^r}R^{r+1}f_{0!}F'\to\cdots$$
is exact. The sequence is natural in morphisms of short exact Weil sequences. In particular the consecutive same-degree maps are exact at $R^rf_{0!}F$. The underlying connecting map is the cohomology boundary obtained by applying the underlying exact functor $Rf_!$ to the canonical triangle of the short exact sequence in the constructible heart. The assertion includes compatibility of these boundaries with the induced Weil structures, rather than assuming a distinguished triangle of fixed pairs.

source.place: Part 3: the underlying heart triangle, its image under Rf_!, and the Weil-equivariant cohomology sequence (old step 11).

proof.text: Write $\mathcal T_X=D^b_c(X,\Qlb)$ and $\mathcal T_Y=D^b_c(Y,\Qlb)$, $G_X=Lg_X^*$ and $G_Y=Lg_Y^*$. The geometric morphism $f$ and its source and target are separated of finite type by [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change]. The standard bounded t-structures and heart-valued cohomology are supplied by [prop-constructible-truncations]. Pullback by each geometric Frobenius is an exact triangulated functor by the common-stage pullback clause of [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors], and its restriction to the constructible heart is exact by [lem-a1-constructible-pullback-t-exact]. Thus both $G_X$ and $G_Y$ satisfy the hypotheses of the t-exact boundary comparison [lem-zl-texact-cohomology-boundary-comparison]. Denote their cohomology comparisons by $c^r_M:G H^r(M)\simeq H^r(GM)$.

source.place: Part 3: coefficient category, standard cohomology, and Frobenius pullback hypotheses.

proof.text: The heart is abelian by [prop-weil-heart-abelian]. In its category of $G$-fixed pairs [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], kernels and cokernels of an intertwining arrow are its underlying kernel and cokernel: exactness of $G$ identifies $G\ker u$ with $\ker Gu$ and $G\operatorname{coker}u$ with $\operatorname{coker}Gu$ by [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology](a). The source and target structure isomorphisms induce the required structure isomorphisms on these objects; the inverse structures induce their inverses. A unique underlying kernel or cokernel factorization intertwines, as follows by composing with the kernel monomorphism or precomposing with the cokernel epimorphism. Biproducts are likewise underlying biproducts. Hence the forgetful functor preserves kernels, cokernels and images and reflects exactness: the underlying coimage-to-image isomorphism has an intertwining inverse. In particular the given short exact Weil sequence is short exact in the underlying constructible heart, and underlying exactness of the sequence we construct will suffice.

source.place: Part 3: passage between the constructible Weil heart and its underlying heart.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles](4) to obtain the canonical distinguished triangle $T=(F'\xrightarrow a F\xrightarrow b F''\xrightarrow t F'[1])$ in $\mathcal T_X$. It is natural in short exact sequences: for a commuting triple $(u',u,u'')$, (TR3) of [def-weil-triangulated-category] supplies a triangle map on its first two components. Its third component $v$ satisfies $vb=b_{\rm target}u=u''b$, so $v=u''$ because $b$ is epic in the heart. Thus $t_{\rm target}u''=u'[1]t$. Apply this to the short exact sequence $G_XT$ and the three Weil isomorphisms $\theta',\theta,\theta''$. Exactness and t-exactness from step 1 ensure that $G_XT$ is the heart triangle of the pulled-back sequence, with its last arrow followed by the shift comparison of $G_X$. The same argument gives $t\theta''=\theta'[1]G_X(t)$, with that shift comparison understood. Therefore $t:F''\to F'[1]$ is an intertwining morphism, without claiming that fixed pairs form a triangulated category.

source.place: Part 3: canonical underlying heart triangle and functoriality in the short exact sequence.

proof.text: Put $H=Rf_!$. By [lem-zl-field-shriek-lower-bound], $H$ preserves bounded constructibility and is exact triangulated, so $HT=(HF'\to HF\to HF''\xrightarrow d HF'[1])$ is distinguished, where $d=\sigma_{F',1}H(t)$. Its first two arrows and $H(t)$ are morphisms of fixed pairs by [lem-fix-weil-operations]. Its shift comparison $\sigma_{F',1}$ is an isomorphism of fixed pairs by [lem-zl-weil-shriek-shift-compatibility]. Consequently $d$ intertwines the induced Weil structure on $HF''$ and the shifted structure on $HF'[1]$. All three arrows of this underlying triangle therefore commute with the Weil isomorphisms; equivalently these isomorphisms give a morphism of underlying triangles $G_Y(HT)\to HT$.

source.place: Part 3: apply the exact compact-support functor, retaining the last arrow and its equivariant shift comparison.

proof.text:
By [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles](5) and [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle], the cohomology of $HT$ gives the underlying long exact sequence, with boundary $\delta^r:H^r(HF'')\to H^{r+1}(HF')$ induced by $d$. Its terms lie in the constructible heart. On $H^r(M)$ the induced Weil structure is $\Theta^r_M=H^r(\theta_M)c^r_M$, using [prop-constructible-truncations]. Naturality of $c^r$ shows that each same-degree map intertwines: for an intertwining $u:M\to N$,
$$H^r(u)\Theta^r_M=H^r(\theta_N)H^r(G_Yu)c^r_M=\Theta^r_NG_Y(H^r(u)).$$
Here the first equality uses $u\theta_M=\theta_NG_Yu$. This also identifies the same-degree arrows with the specified $R^rf_{0!}a,R^rf_{0!}b$.

source.place: Part 3: underlying long exact cohomology sequence and its same-degree Weil maps.

proof.text:
Set $A=HF'$ and $C=HF''$. The morphism of triangles in step 4 and naturality of the boundary [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle] give
$$\delta^r_{HT}H^r(\theta_C)=H^{r+1}(\theta_A)\delta^r_{G_Y(HT)}.$$
The t-exact boundary comparison [lem-zl-texact-cohomology-boundary-comparison], applied to the exact t-exact functor $G_Y$, gives
$$\delta^r_{G_Y(HT)}c^r_C=c^{r+1}_A G_Y(\delta^r_{HT}).$$
Compose the first equality on the right with $c^r_C$ and substitute the second. The result is precisely
$$\delta^r\Theta^r_C=\Theta^{r+1}_A G_Y(\delta^r),$$
so every connecting map is a morphism of constructible Weil sheaves. This computation includes the canonical shift comparison in both image triangles, as required by the comparison lemma; it does not infer boundary compatibility from naturality of the unshifted exchange alone.

source.place: Part 3: explicit Frobenius square for the cohomology connecting map.

proof.text: Every term and every arrow of the underlying long exact sequence is now a constructible Weil sheaf or a Weil morphism. The kernel/image construction in step 2 reflects exactness, so this is an exact sequence in the constructible Weil heart at every term, including the terms next to a boundary and the middle same-degree term. For a morphism of short exact Weil sequences, step 3 gives its underlying triangle morphism; applying the exact functor $H$ gives the corresponding morphism of image triangles. Naturality of the long exact sequence [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle] says that its cohomology maps commute also with the boundaries. All these maps intertwine by step 5, so this is naturality in the Weil heart. By construction its underlying boundary is exactly the cohomology boundary of the canonical underlying heart triangle after applying $Rf_!$, which proves the final specification of the statement.

source.place: Part 3: exactness in the Weil heart, naturality, and the specified underlying boundary.

proof_origin.place: Part 3, expanded in the underlying common-stage category; naturality and Frobenius boundary square are supplied explicitly, using the existing heart, shift, and cohomology interfaces.
